source_scope: Official Godot3.6.2 MP3 and AudioStreamPlayer APIs, libctru immutable source snapshots; no game content/upstream revision changed.

review.engine_start: AudioStreamPlayer.play(float) stores pending float seek; get_playback_position returns pending seek before mixer consumes it. MP3.seek compares against float stream length, resets beyond length to0 and casts float(sample_rate)*float(time) to uint32 frames. MP3 playback position is frames_mixed/rate, not a wall clock.
review.ndsp_position: ndspWaveBuf.sequence_id is assigned nonzero u16 on queue, wraps from65535 to1. GetSamplePos and GetWaveBufSeq observe DSP-updated current buffer fields. Their two reads are not an atomic pair; bounded sequence checks yield Pending on detected inconsistencies. Output corresponds to DSP playback observation, not Godot mixer lookahead/latency.
review.admission_boundary: Nonfinite/negative or float-overflow starts fail closed. Zero start remains admitted for prior codecs; nonzero starts currently admit audited lower-case .mp3 sources only. Stable current route+generation/provider/channel lease required for observation. No stopped/unrouted-position query support or actual device timing guarantee.
